Oman has reached an understanding with Iran on coordinates of a route through Hormuz, easing border security concerns
Hezbollah ceasefire violations in southern Lebanon have led to Israeli military strikes, heightening regional diplomatic tensions

markets.method_note: Threat beta = OLS of daily log-returns on the index change at the lead lag; launch-day estimates lean on BNTI-seeded history. Association, not causation.
